# Algorithm Correctness & Mathematical Rigor Checklist: Community Detection Framework

**Purpose**: Validate that algorithm correctness requirements, mathematical guarantees, and edge case specifications are complete, consistent, measurable, and unambiguous
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Connected Communities Guarantee

- [x] CHK001 Are the conditions under which Leiden produces connected communities distinguished from algorithms that MAY produce disconnected communities, and is this distinction unambiguous? [Clarity, Consistency, FR-006/FR-023]
- [x] CHK002 Is the `has_disconnected_communities()` method's contract fully specified: return value semantics (true = disconnected found), traversal algorithm (BFS/DFS), and computational complexity? [Completeness, FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Is the distinction between "a community consisting of multiple disconnected components" (allowed) vs "two distinct graph components merged into one community" (forbidden) specified consistently across FR-006, FR-023, and the user stories? [Consistency, FR-006/FR-023]
- [x] CHK004 Are the verification requirements for connected communities specified in terms that are objectively measurable (BFS/DFS traversal) rather than vague ("internally connected")? [Measurability, FR-006, SC-001]
- [x] CHK005 Is the requirement that disconnected graph components MUST never be merged (FR-023) specified as a universal guarantee or algorithm-specific? Is it clear how this is verified for non-Leiden algorithms? [Clarity, Coverage, FR-023]

## Determinism & Reproducibility

- [x] CHK006 Is the determinism requirement (FR-007) specified with sufficient precision: does "optional seed parameter (u64)" define the default behavior when no seed is provided? [Clarity, Gap, FR-007]
- [x] CHK007 Is the success criterion for determinism (SC-002: "identical partitions across 100 independent runs") measurable and the threshold (100 runs) justified? [Measurability, SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are all stochastic phases in all five algorithms identified as requiring seed control, or is it clear which phases are stochastic vs deterministic? [Completeness, Gap, FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Is the assumption that "deterministic execution with a fixed seed may sacrifice some optimization quality" quantified or bounded? Is the acceptable quality degradation specified? [Clarity, Assumption]

## Convergence & Termination

- [x] CHK010 Are the convergence criteria (FR-031) specified with both the threshold value (1e-6) AND the mode (absolute/relative), and is the default mode unambiguous? [Completeness, FR-031]
- [x] CHK011 Is the termination guarantee (FR-026) specified with both convergence detection AND maximum iteration bound? Is the maximum iteration bound value defined? [Completeness, Gap, FR-026]
- [x] CHK012 Are the time complexity bounds for each algorithm phase (O(V+E) for local moving, O(V+E*log V) for flow optimization) specified consistently across FR-026 and the plan? [Consistency, FR-026]
- [x] CHK013 Is the convergence threshold's interaction with different quality functions (Modularity, CPM, Map Equation) specified? Do all quality functions use the same convergence criteria? [Clarity, Gap, FR-031/FR-020]
- [x] CHK014 Are the conditions for "convergence plateau" detection specified, and is this event emission requirement (FR-017) distinguishable from normal convergence? [Clarity, FR-017]

## Edge Cases & Boundary Conditions

- [x] CHK015 Are requirements specified for ALL of the following edge cases: empty graphs (FR-021), isolated nodes (FR-022), zero-weight edges (FR-024), self-loops (FR-025), negative weights (FR-032), bipartite graphs, cyclic rings, and fully disconnected graphs? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK016 Is the requirement for isolated nodes (FR-022: "each assigned to their own unique single-member community") specified as universal across all algorithms or Leiden-specific? [Clarity, Consistency, FR-022]
- [x] CHK017 Is the behavior for graphs with nodes but no edges fully specified: does FR-021 (empty partition, quality 0) take precedence over FR-022 (isolated nodes get own communities)? [Conflict, FR-021/FR-022]
- [x] CHK018 Are the validation requirements for negative edge weights (FR-032) specified with the default behavior AND the opt-out mechanism clearly distinguished? [Clarity, FR-032]
- [x] CHK019 Is the self-loop handling requirement (FR-025) specified in terms of both degree calculation AND quality metric computation? Are edge cases like graphs consisting only of self-loops addressed? [Completeness, Gap, FR-025]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements specified for graphs with a single node, single edge, or two disconnected nodes? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]

## Quality Metrics & Mathematical Definitions

- [x] CHK021 Are the mathematical formulas for all quality metrics (Modularity Q, CPM, Map Equation, NMI, ARI) either specified by reference or defined in the requirements? [Completeness, Gap, FR-020]
- [x] CHK022 Is the resolution parameter (gamma) requirement (FR-008) specified for both CPM and modularity, and is the valid range of gamma values defined? [Completeness, FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is the symmetrization formula (arithmetic mean per FR-029) specified consistently across all requirements that reference it, and is the interaction with directed graphs clear? [Consistency, FR-029]
- [x] CHK024 Are the quality metric requirements (FR-020) separated clearly from the comparative metrics (FR-019), and is it clear which metrics are used for optimization vs. evaluation? [Clarity, FR-019/FR-020]
- [x] CHK025 Is the Map Equation requirement specified for both internal algorithm use (Infomap optimization) and external evaluation, and is this dual use documented? [Completeness, Gap, FR-020]

## Dynamic Graph Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Is the O(k) complexity requirement for incremental updates (FR-014) specified with a precise definition of k (2-hop neighborhood) and is it clear this refers to time complexity only? [Clarity, FR-014]
- [x] CHK027 Are the requirements for edge deletion that disconnects a community (FR-013: "immediate split") specified with the trigger condition, the split mechanism, and the resulting state? [Completeness, FR-013]
- [x] CHK028 Is the subtree stability requirement (FR-015) specified with measurable criteria for what constitutes "stable" between mutations? [Measurability, Gap, FR-015]
- [x] CHK029 Are the hierarchical tree slice requirements (FR-016) specified with the semantics of "coarse-to-fine" and the API contract for requesting specific levels? [Clarity, Gap, FR-016]
- [x] CHK030 Is the scope of dynamic graph support (edge insertions/deletions only, no node mutations) consistently specified across FR-013, user stories, and assumptions? [Consistency, FR-013]

## Observability & Stepping

- [x] CHK031 Are the observable event types (FR-017) enumerated completely: phase starts, node relocations, refinement splits, aggregation contractions, convergence plateaus—are any missing? [Completeness, FR-017]
- [x] CHK032 Is the distinction between "base observability" and "full observability" (FR-017) specified with clear criteria for what each tier includes? [Clarity, FR-017]
- [x] CHK033 Is the 20% overhead budget (SC-013) specified with the exact measurement formula, baseline definition, and test conditions? [Measurability, SC-013]
- [x] CHK034 Are the stepping mode requirements (FR-018) specified for both iterator and callback interfaces with their respective contracts (pause/resume semantics, callback invocation timing)? [Completeness, FR-018]
- [x] CHK035 Is the zero-cost requirement for observability when not enabled specified with measurable criteria? [Measurability, Gap, FR-017]

## Error Handling & Validation

- [x] CHK036 Are error handling requirements specified for all fallible operations: invalid graph input, negative weights, algorithm convergence failure, invalid configuration? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK037 Is the zero-trust logging posture (FR-030) specified with the complete list of protected data types (graph data, node identifiers, topology) and all logging tier definitions? [Completeness, FR-030]
- [x] CHK038 Are the graph builder validation requirements (FR-027) specified with the `validate_on_construction` flag behavior for both true and false cases? [Clarity, FR-027]
- [x] CHK039 Is the typed algorithm config requirement (FR-028) specified with the common trait contract and the expectation that invalid configs are caught at compile time? [Clarity, FR-028]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK040 Are performance requirements specified with measurable thresholds: observability overhead (SC-013: <=20%), incremental update complexity (SC-005: O(k), R²>=0.9)? [Measurability, SC-005/SC-013]
- [x] CHK041 Is the determinism requirement (SC-002) specified with the measurement methodology (100 runs, identical partitions)? [Measurability, SC-002]
- [x] CHK042 Are the benchmark validation requirements (SC-003, SC-004) specified with specific graphs, thresholds (NMI>=0.80, NMI>=0.95), and reference data sourcing? [Completeness, SC-003/SC-004]
- [x] CHK043 Is the scale-agnostic requirement specified with measurable criteria, or is it an untestable assumption? [Measurability, Assumption]
- [x] CHK044 Are the WASM constraints (single-threaded, Leiden+Louvain only) specified as requirements or assumptions, and is the build customization tool in scope? [Clarity, Gap, Assumption]

## Consistency & Conflict Detection

- [x] CHK045 Is the relationship between FR-006 (Leiden connected communities) and FR-023 (no merging of disconnected components) free of contradiction across all five algorithms? [Consistency, FR-006/FR-023]
- [x] CHK046 Are the quality metric definitions consistent between FR-020 (system computes), the plan (communal-metrics crate), and the contracts? [Consistency, FR-020]
- [x] CHK047 Is the convergence threshold default (1e-6) specified consistently across FR-031, the assumptions, and the algorithm configs? [Consistency, FR-031]
- [x] CHK048 Are the algorithm iteration complexity claims (FR-026: O(V+E) and O(V+E*log V)) consistent with the algorithm research literature? [Consistency, FR-026]
- [x] CHK049 Is the resolution parameter (gamma) default value (1.0) specified consistently across FR-008, the assumptions, and algorithm configs? [Consistency, FR-008]

## Traceability & Assumptions

- [x] CHK050 Are all assumptions (Section: Assumptions) testable or clearly identified as untestable design decisions? [Traceability, Assumption]
- [x] CHK051 Is each functional requirement (FR-001 through FR-033) traceable to at least one success criterion or acceptance scenario? [Traceability, Gap]
- [x] CHK052 Are external dependencies (petgraph API, SNAP dataset formats, LFR benchmark specification) documented with version or reference? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK053 Is the forward-compatibility requirement for multiplex support (FR-033) specified with the sealed trait pattern as the mechanism, and is this verifiable? [Clarity, FR-033]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK054 Are all success criteria (SC-001 through SC-015) measurable with specific thresholds, measurement methodologies, and clear pass/fail conditions? [Measurability, Gap]
- [x] CHK055 Do the user story acceptance scenarios cover primary flows, alternate flows, AND exception flows for each story? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK056 Are the acceptance scenarios for User Story 4 (dynamic updates) covering: successful insertion, successful deletion, deletion causing split, and stability verification? [Coverage, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK057 Are the acceptance scenarios for User Story 5 (observability) covering both iterator AND callback interfaces? [Coverage, User Story 5]
